description: Place an order against the agent_session_id from start_order_session. Atomically inserts the order + items, applies server-side canonical pricing + tax (do NOT trust the unit_price you compute — we re-read it from D1), decrements inventory and optionally redeems a promo code. The guest pays at the venue (payment_status 'unpaid'). At a venue that takes payment before preparing (pay_first: true) the order is held as 'awaiting' and payment_url is returned: give it to the guest — they pay on the restaurant's own checkout, exactly like a guest ordering from the table; the kitchen gets the order once it is paid, and an unpaid order expires. This tool never charges anything itself. Returns order_id, total_cents (tax-inclusive), currency, promo_discount and, when pay_first, payment_url. Idempotency-Key header REQUIRED.

customer_name.description: Required for takeaway — who picks the order up.

customer_phone.description: Required for takeaway — reachable phone (digits, +, spaces/dashes tolerated).

guest_name.description: Optional guest name shown to staff with the order.

order_type.description: Channel: 'dine_in' (default — at a table) or 'takeaway' (pickup; requires customer_name + customer_phone, ignores table_id, only when the restaurant has takeaway enabled — else channel_not_available). Delivery is not offered to agents.

promo_code.description: Optional promo code to redeem at order time (validate first with apply_promo). The redemption slot is consumed only when this order lands.

table_id.description: Optional table id when ordering at a table.

name: place_order
title: Place an order
